'''Wandara Dekort''' was the [[Minister of Justice (Galactic Alliance)|Minister of Justice]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] in [[45 ABY]]. [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Luewet Wuul]] believed Dekort might have been bribed, blackmailed, or threatened by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]] into overlooking their criminal activities.<ref name="Crucible" />
